title: BJP launches foot marches to counter opposition rally in Delhi
seoTitle: Delhi BJP foot marches and counter-rallies

tea.why: The BJP is launching foot marches across the country to counter an opposition alliance rally and respond to allegations regarding voter list revisions.
tea.want: To present facts regarding the electoral roll revision process directly to the public and raise awareness about democratic values.
tea.changed: Oct 26: The BJP finalised its blueprint to deploy top leaders and union ministers for nationwide foot marches.

summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) announced a campaign of month-long foot marches ("padyatras") across India, including events in Delhi, to counter an upcoming mega gathering planned by the INDIA Bloc. According to the sources, the opposition alliance organised its demonstration to protest against the Election Commission of India over alleged irregularities in the ongoing Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls and demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. In response, the BJP decided to deploy senior party figures, Union Ministers, and Chief Ministers to lead outreach efforts, present facts about the electoral roll process, and target the opposition alliance. The Delhi Police issued a No-Objection Certificate clearing security and traffic for events spanning from October 25 to November 3.
demands: Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
Action regarding alleged irregularities in electoral rolls
response: Delhi Police issued a No-Objection Certificate clearing security and traffic coordination for events from October 25 to November 3, as reported by OrissaPOST.

updates.text: The BJP announced month-long foot marches to counter the INDIA Bloc's planned November 1 rally.
